cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Move It for Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to rearrange an ordinary commitment as proof that your relationship takes priority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Move your haircut so we can have lunch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. We've been friends since school. Couldn't I have its place just once?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They charge twenty pounds if I change it today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll pay. Put lunch in that exact slot, in pen. You've used pencil for me since school.

mechanism: A calls moving a routine appointment proof that its former pupil values their relationship and has learned flexibility.
confusable: Not merely preferring lunch: A insists the other commitment actually move to demonstrate personal priority.
comparison: Paid haircut reschedule versus naming family loyalty when leaving a quiz.
seedUse: Use D35 long-booked haircut/change fee/exact slot; S05 taught planning and flexibility become leverage for relationship ranking.
